rows.section: FAQ - What tax rate does my small corporation pay in Ontario?
rows.before: A qualifying Ontario CCPC pays a combined 12.2% on the first $500,000 of active business income, made up of 3.2% provincial and 9% federal.
rows.after: A qualifying Ontario CCPC pays a combined 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) on the first $500,000 of active business income, made up of 2.2% (3.2% before July 1, 2026) provincial and 9% federal.
rows.note: Stated as the current rate. The next sentence ('On July 1, 2026 the provincial rate drops to 2.2%, bringing the combined rate to 11.2%.') becomes redundant after this change; Sharad may want to delete it.
